_metadata.purpose: every owner request reconciled in x03 (2026-10-19): the 22 x02 owner pairs, the x03 owner additions (added as owner decisions), and the variations the owner asked us to review (independent review decides). Checked by scripts/unlimited/x03-requests.mjs.
_metadata.intents: owner_add = owner decision, added with --approve; owner_add_held = owner-requested but held pending an owner clarification; review = candidate for independent review; rejected / held = recorded in data/unlimited/library/rejections.json
_metadata.links: links.<WORD> is the short line shown beside that word on the reveal screen; why is the explanation sentence
_metadata.supplement: The 'later supplement' named in the x03 brief was not found in any file or session transcript on this machine. Its decisions that the x03 brief restates (section 4) are recorded as rejections/holds; anything else it contained is not reconciled here.
